items.title: Kennametal, Proto Labs, and Johnson Controls Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after the latest industrial production report showed slower-than-expected growth for July. Data from the Federal Reserve indicated that U.S. industrial production rose by 0.2%, which was half of the 0.4% increase that analysts polled by The Wall Street Journal had anticipated.
